# Final Electronics Engineering Capstone

Design a substantial low-voltage electronic system such as a solar environmental monitor, battery-powered controller, motor controller, measurement instrument, or industrial sensor node. Deliver measurable requirements, safety analysis, architecture, calculations, schematic, simulations, firmware design, PCB review, bring-up plan, verification matrix, annotated measurements, fault injection, EMI and thermal review, and a design defense.
learningObjectives: Integrate analog, digital, embedded, power, layout, and troubleshooting skills
Design safe states and fault containment
